summary.headline: Quiet broad tape (SPY +0.59%, QQQ +1.15%, both at/near record closes) masks two real name-specific stories. MARA escalates AMBER->RED: a Q2 miss reported 2026-08-06 ($611M net loss vs. an expected profit, revenue -27% YoY, $343M of the loss from BTC mark-to-market) has now driven three straight down sessions (-5.25%, -5.07%, -5.34%) for a cumulative ~-15% decline -- a direct hit on MARA's own key_risk about Bitcoin-price-derivative earnings. Correcting yesterday's record: MARA's earnings date was mis-logged as 2026-08-12 in the calendar; they were actually reported 2026-08-06, so yesterday's flag partially misattributed the move to the same-day analyst downgrade alone. EIX persists RED -- Aug 31 wildfire-liability-reform deadline now 23 days out, still no draft legislation found, CEO's credit-downgrade warning still live (price actually +2.10% today, a rebound, not a resolution of the underlying regulatory risk). CWAN roster-integrity bug hits a 40th consecutive day (PR #11/#12 still unmerged). New AMBER: NTR (-3.48%, Q2 EPS miss $2.61 vs $2.89 est. reported 8/5, revenue beat, tracks its own weak-profitability key_risk) and HUT (-2.32%, continuing digestion of last week's Q2 BTC mark-to-market loss, but offset by $7.5B in new project financing and several analyst price-target raises -- a more mixed picture than MARA's). FTNT resolved to green (-0.32%, stabilized, no new deterioration in analyst sentiment since 8/7's flag). CRDO (+8.49%) and AEM (+6.48%) were the day's largest gainers -- CRDO on continued AI-datacenter connectivity demand (no single new catalyst found), AEM on gold strength; both informational only.

flags.headline: Q2 2026 earnings miss (reported 8/6) driving a 3rd straight down session; thesis-confirmed Bitcoin-derivative earnings risk
flags.detail: MARA -5.34% today to $10.11 (from $10.68), the 3rd consecutive down session since Q2 2026 results on 2026-08-06: net loss of $611M ($1.60/share) vs. consensus for a $0.35 profit, revenue -27% YoY to $175M (missed $208.4M consensus by 16%), with $343M of the loss from unrealized Bitcoin mark-to-market. Morgan Stanley cut its PT to $5.50 (Underweight reiterated) same week; a Form 144 insider-sale filing was also noted. Cumulative decline since the print is roughly -15%. Correction to the record: the calendar previously (and incorrectly) listed MARA's Q2 print as due 2026-08-12; it was actually reported 2026-08-06 -- removing the stale calendar entry this run.
flags.thesis_link: Direct hit on two MARA key_risks: 'Persistent GAAP losses driven by Bitcoin price volatility and mark-to-market accounting create existential risk...' and 'Revenue concentration in Bitcoin mining means MARA's financial performance is essentially a leveraged derivative of Bitcoin price -- the company has no proven ability to generate profits independent of crypto market conditions.' This quarter is exactly that risk materializing.

flags.headline: Wildfire-liability-reform deadline (Aug 31, now 23 days out) unresolved; CEO's credit-downgrade warning still live
flags.detail: EIX +2.10% today ($68.62) -- a price rebound, not a resolution. No draft wildfire-liability-reform legislation has been reported as of this run; CEO Pedro Pizarro's warning that a credit-supportive framework must pass by the Aug 31 legislative deadline to avoid likely rating downgrades for SCE remains the live, unresolved risk. Utility Dive coverage as of early August confirms no legislative movement yet, with the session ending soon.
flags.thesis_link: Matches EIX key_risk: 'Elevated debt-to-equity of 216% amplifies financial risk from future wildfire events, adverse rate case outcomes, or rising interest rates -- despite mitigation investments, a single catastrophic fire in SCE's territory could create material liability.' A credit downgrade would directly worsen this exposure.

evidence.source: Yahoo Finance / Edison International CEO statement

flags.headline: Q2 2026 EPS miss ($2.61 vs $2.89 est.), revenue beat; -3.48% today
flags.detail: NTR -3.48% today ($64.42), continuing to digest Q2 2026 results reported 2026-08-05: EPS of $2.61 missed the $2.89 consensus by $0.28, though revenue of $10.81B beat expectations. A quarterly dividend of $0.55/share was maintained. Mixed print -- profitability miss against a revenue beat -- reads as a single soft data point rather than a thesis break.
flags.thesis_link: Matches NTR key_risk: 'Weak profitability profile -- ROE of 9.2% and profit margin of 8.7% are structurally below targets for an agricultural commodity business, limiting the stock's ability to command a premium valuation.' An EPS miss is a direct data point on that weakness.

evidence.source: GuruFocus (NTR shares fall on Q2 print)

flags.headline: Continuing digestion of Q2 BTC mark-to-market loss; offset by strong contracted-AI financing news
flags.detail: HUT -2.32% today ($88.57). Q2 2026 results (revenue +81% YoY, but a $177.1M net loss driven primarily by unrealized Bitcoin losses) continue to weigh on the stock. Countervailing positives found this run: $7.5B in new non-recourse, investment-grade project financing, ~$26.6B in aggregate contracted AI data-center value across 949MW, and price-target raises from Piper Sandler ($143) and Clear Street ($170). Net picture is mixed, not a clean thesis break -- capped at AMBER.
